# Test fixture provenance

Media under `workspace-template/media`, the synthetic dog image, and the sample
workspace receipt are generated by `pnpm fixtures:generate`. They contain no
third-party photographs, music, trademarks, personal data, or model output.
The generator requires `ffmpeg` for its audio and video fixtures and ReportLab
for the original marketing-demo research-note PDF.

Other documents under this directory are synthetic test inputs maintained with
the source. Third-party formats, runtimes, models, and dependencies retain their
own licenses; see `docs/dependency-licensing.md`.
